title: Agronomy knowledge guides for fertilizers and pesticides
changes: Replaced placeholder fertilizer and pesticide pages with structured, searchable agronomy learning guides.
Added nutrient roles, common deficiency indicators, fertilizer handling principles, and soil/water analysis safeguards.
Added integrated pest management workflow, pesticide category guidance, label checks, PHI/REI, resistance management, and safety practices.
Kept chemical product names, active ingredients, and application rates out of the guide unless Iraqi registration and exact official labels can be verified.
Updated backup metadata and visible app version to 1.8.2.
safety_limits: No universal fertilizer rates are supplied; field rates require crop, stage, soil/water tests, irrigation system, and product analysis.
No pesticide product, active ingredient, or spray rate is recommended; users must verify current Iraqi registration and the exact label.
Content is educational and requires local agronomist review before being treated as an official field recommendation.
